text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria's first pluralist National Assembly (lower house) elects Abdelkader Bensalah, leader of the National Democratic Rally (RND), as house speaker.

- "It is the feeling of just gratitude and respect towards a wise man dedicated for dialogue that a huge majority of the assembly wanted to express in electing Bensalah as speaker of the lower house."

- The RND, grouping President Liamine Zeroual's supporters, and (former ruling) National Liberation Front have agreed to form a majority in the parliament after the RND waved the threat of forging an alliance with the Islamist-oriented Movement of a Peaceful Society.

- The Constitutional Council, ruling on parties' complaints on the official outcome of the June 5 multi-party legislative election, awarded secular Socialist Forces Front and RND parties one extra seat each. The FLN lost two seats in the ruling.

- Trade union worker, Zidour Rachid, was shot dead on Monday night in a battle opposing pro-government, anti-Islamist men and Moslem rebels in Tipaza province, west of Algiers. The dead man was a member of the pro-government camp.
